subject: Web Development
title: Open Source and the Commons
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Open Source and the Commons.

hook.text: The web runs on open source. Linux, Apache, Node.js, and React are all community-built.

buildup.text: Open source creates a digital commons — shared infrastructure anyone can use and improve.

discovery.text: Companies worth billions depend on code maintained by volunteers working nights and weekends.

twist.text: The xz Utils backdoor in 2024 showed how a single volunteer's burnout can create security crises.

climax.text: The web's future depends on sustaining the open source commons that everything is built on.

punchline.text: The web's foundation is volunteer labor.

quiz.question: What risk does open source face?
